title: Susi GEMI algorithmic masterpiece: Bayesian UCB1/Pareto brain, Dirichlet NB classifier, SPRT/EVOI escalation, Dawid-Skene consensus, exact GQA KV roofline, phi-accrual hedged failover, and closed-form speculative gamma solver
